ILO: secure and fast, but no entity markup.

security.txt is published, HSTS covers subdomains, and DMARC rejects spoofed mail. But no page analyzed carries JSON-LD, so the Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube profiles it links are never tied to the ILO.

The lesson for every team: Add Organization markup with url, logo and sameAs so AI answers name you right.

HSTS with preload, framing limited to its own origin, a declared language, and every internal link opened answered. But the home page search box and volume slider have no label, so screen readers announce blank fields.

The lesson for every team: Tie each field to a <label for>, or give it an aria-label. A screen reader can only announce a name that exists.

WTO: no viewport tag on the start page.

Gob.mx can be framed by any other site.

A permanent https redirect, real 404s for unknown paths, and pages that read well without JavaScript. But the start page sends no X-Frame-Options, no CSP frame-ancestors, and no HSTS, so any site can load it in a frame.

The lesson for every team: Send frame-ancestors 'self' in a CSP, or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN. It stops clickjacking on forms.
